properties.SQL Query:
SELECT STRING_AGG(quote_ident(column_name) || ' TEXT', ', ' ORDER BY ordinal_position) AS col_defs
FROM information_schema.columns 
WHERE 
table_catalog ='${source_db}'
AND table_schema = '${source_schema}'
AND table_name ='${source_table}';

properties.CREATE_SCHEMA:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS
  #{Destination Database}.#{Destination Schema}
properties.CREATE_DB:
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS
#{Destination Database}
properties.copy_into:
COPY INTO ${dest_fqn}__LOAD 
FILE_FORMAT = (
  TYPE = CSV
  SKIP_HEADER = 1
  FIELD_OPTIONALLY_ENCLOSED_BY = '"'
  COMPRESSION = GZIP
)
PURGE = TRUE;
properties.CREATE_TAG: CREATE TAG IF NOT EXISTS #{Destination Database}.#{Destination Schema}.PII_TAG
